correctness.rationale: Primitivity lists every nonzero query vector once, and multiplication by alpha traverses each phase state; a nonzero state cannot give the zero sequence by trace nondegeneracy. Dependent coordinates miss a labeling even before deletions. For independent k-sets, all fibers have 2^(m−k) elements; omit zero only from the zero-label fiber. This gives the baseline for k≤m−1, and forbids larger supports. At k=m−1 the kernel is {0,w}; the zero label dies on erasing w; a nonzero label dies exactly if both members of a pair with sum w are erased. Each surviving w contributes the unordered bases of w-perp. At k=m−2 only the zero label can die with three erasures, and only when the deleted states are exactly the nonzero part of its two-dimensional kernel. The three nonzero pair sums of an independent triple are distinct from the states, whereas for a line they are the states. Lower layers survive. This also covers m=3. The lower saturation bound is counting singles and pairs; the upper splits the vector space into complementary subspaces and uses each cross-sum. An independent dot-product replay enumerated all 128 erasure subsets at m=3 and all layers for five patterns at each of m=4,5. It tested for accepted supports by taking the set of observed binary masks on each support; no frozen code was executed. At m=4 the two triple cases gave coefficients (1,15,102,336) and (1,15,105,252) in increasing degree, compared with (1,15,105,420) before erasure.
residual_risks: Finite replay corroborates but does not replace the trace-fiber proof. The whole polynomial below top degree is not claimed for larger D.

value.rationale: The quantity is the loss of realizable Boolean queries after removing hypotheses from a canonical recurrence family, not loss from arbitrarily chosen objects. Three deletions of equal cardinality have opposite effects by layer: a binary line loses fewer maximum supports than an independent triple yet uniquely loses penultimate supports. The exact count makes that failure of cardinality-only robustness explicit and identifies which top queries survive any erasure set. The old saturation bounds alone are not the value claim.
residual_risks: No exact new minimum saturating-set formula or general lower-layer formula for four or more deletions is obtained.
